summary: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. (TMTG) filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of its Business Combination Agreement with Yorkville Acquisition Corp. (SPAC) and Crypto.com entities. The parties entered into a Mutual Termination and Release Agreement on August 7, 2026, effective that date, citing market conditions. The original agreement was dated August 25, 2025, and amended October 31, 2025. No deal terms, fees, or premiums were disclosed. The termination releases all parties from obligations. The SPAC merger, announced to combine TMTG with Crypto.com, is now abandoned. Watch for potential related litigation or strategic alternatives.
